Title: Kerala Sweet Lime (Mosambi) & Ginger Crush
Tagline: Cold-pressed fresh sweet lime juice crushed with crushed ginger juice, black salt, and fresh mint leaves.
Description: The restorative roadside cooler of South India. Sweet fresh Mosambi (sweet lime) cold-pressed and gently muddled with spicy ginger juice, black rock salt, and bruised garden spearmint leaves.
Ingredients_Summary: 4 pieces Fresh Mosambi (Sweet Limes); 1 tsp Fresh Ginger Juice; 0.25 tsp Black Salt (Kala Namak); 6 leaves Fresh Mint Leaves

Title: Ruby Pomegranate & Mint Cold-Press Elixir
Tagline: Cold-pressed jewel-like ruby pomegranate arils lifted with Persian lime and bruised spearmint.
Description: An antioxidant powerhouse juice. Deep crimson arils cold-pressed gently to preserve delicate polyphenols, kissed with freshly squeezed lime juice, pink Himalayan salt, and crushed garden mint.
Ingredients_Summary: 3 cups Ruby Red Pomegranate Arils; 8 leaves Fresh Mint Leaves; 1 tbsp Fresh Persian Lime Juice; 1 pinch Pink Himalayan Rock Salt

Title: Tropical Watermelon & Thai Basil Cooler
Tagline: Hydrating cold watermelon flesh blended with peppery Thai basil leaves and a squeeze of fresh lime.
Description: The ultimate hot weather hydrator. Sweet red seedless watermelon flesh blended pure with peppery fresh basil leaves, sea salt, and fresh lime juice poured over cracked ice.
Ingredients_Summary: 4 cups Chilled Seedless Watermelon Cubes; 8 leaves Fresh Basil Leaves; 1 tbsp Fresh Lime Juice

Title: Classic ABC Detox Juice (Apple, Beetroot, Carrot)
Tagline: Cold-pressed crisp green apple, earthy red beetroot, sweet carrot, and a kick of fresh ginger.
Description: The world-famous cleansing tonic. Organic crisp apples, raw deep red beetroot, and sweet tender carrots cold-pressed together with a knob of spicy ginger root and fresh lemon.
Ingredients_Summary: 1 piece Crisp Green Apple; 1 piece Red Beetroot; 2 pieces Sweet Orange Carrots; 1 inch Fresh Ginger & Lemon

Title: Crushed Pineapple & Pink Peppercorn Cold Juice
Tagline: Golden ripe pineapple juice crushed with fragrant pink peppercorns, rock salt, and mint sprigs.
Description: Vibrant tropical refreshment. Ripe sweet Vazhakulam pineapple cold-pressed with fragrant crushed pink peppercorns and black salt for an irresistible sweet, tangy, and floral spice contrast.
Ingredients_Summary: 500 g Ripe Vazhakulam Pineapple; 0.5 tsp Crushed Pink or Black Peppercorns; 0.25 tsp Black Salt

Title: Pure Cold-Pressed Valencia Orange Juice
Tagline: Pure, unadulterated cold-pressed sweet orange juice with natural juicy citrus pulp and no added sugar.
Description: The gold morning standard. Farm-fresh Valencia oranges freshly halved and pressed, bursting with natural vitamin C, sunshine brightness, and sweet citrus oils without added sugar or water.
Ingredients_Summary: 5 pieces Fresh Valencia Oranges

Title: Cooling Green Cucumber, Celery & Lemon Juice
Tagline: Hydrating crisp English cucumbers, mineral-rich celery stalks, mint, and fresh lemon.
Description: Ultra-hydrating alkaline green juice. Crisp garden cucumbers cold-pressed with crunchy celery stalks, baby spinach, fresh spearmint, and lemon juice for clean, refreshing hydration.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 pieces English Cucumber; 3 stalks Celery Stalks; 1 tbsp Lemon Juice & Mint

Title: Tropical Red Papaya & Passion Fruit Nectar
Tagline: Velvety ripe red papaya pureed with tangy aromatic purple passion fruit pulp and lime.
Description: A match made in tropical heaven. Buttery sweet ripe red papaya pureed with the vibrant tart floral crunch of fresh purple passion fruit pulp and a splash of cold coconut water.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 cups Ripe Red Papaya Flesh; 3 pieces Fresh Passion Fruit Pulp; 1 cup Tender Coconut Water

Title: Fresh Amla (Indian Gooseberry) & Honey Immunity Shot
Tagline: Cold-pressed fresh green Indian gooseberries blended with ginger, raw honey, and a pinch of black pepper.
Description: Ayurvedic daily rejuvenation tonic. Fresh tart Kerala amla (nellikka) deseeded, blended with spicy ginger, sweetened with raw wild honey, and activated with freshly cracked black pepper.
Ingredients_Summary: 4 pieces Fresh Green Amla (Gooseberries); 2 tbsp Raw Honey; 1 tsp Fresh Ginger & Black Pepper

Title: Ripe Pink Guava & Bird's Eye Chili Spicy Cooler
Tagline: Velvety pink Taiwanese guava pulp blended with a split bird's eye chili, pink salt, and lime.
Description: The sensational Kerala street-side specialty. Soft sweet pink guavas pureed smooth, strained of hard seeds, kissed with a bruised bird's eye chili (kanthari mulaku), black salt, and fresh lime.
Ingredients_Summary: 3 pieces Ripe Pink Guavas; 1 piece Kerala Bird's Eye Chili (Kanthari); 1 tsp Black Salt & Lemon Juice

Title: Authentic Malabar Sharjah Shake (Creamy Banana Horlicks)
Tagline: Frozen milk crystals blended with small Kerala Njalipoovan bananas, malted Horlicks, and roasted peanuts.
Description: The undisputed cult milkshake of Kerala juice stalls since the 1980s. Frozen rock-hard milk blended into a thick blizzard with sweet small Njalipoovan bananas, malted milk powder (Horlicks or Boost), roasted peanuts, and finished with honey-roasted nuts.
Ingredients_Summary: 500 ml Full-Cream Milk (Frozen into solid block); 2 pieces Small Kerala Bananas (Njalipoovan or Robusta); 3 tbsp Horlicks or Boost Malt Powder; 2 tbsp Roasted Skinless Peanuts; 2 tbsp Sugar or Condensed Milk; 1 tbsp Cashews and Tutti Frutti

Title: Pune Royal Alphonso Mango Mastani Shake
Tagline: Rich Alphonso mango milkshake crowned with a scoop of mango ice cream, glazed cherries, and slivered dry fruits.
Description: The royal milkshake of Pune named after warrior queen Mastani. Luscious ripe Ratnagiri Alphonso mango pulp blended with rich milk, poured into tall glasses, crowned with an opulent scoop of mango ice cream, candied cherries, slivered almonds, and saffron.
Ingredients_Summary: 1.5 cups Alphonso Mango Pulp; 1.5 cups Chilled Full-Cream Milk; 2 scoops Alphonso Mango Ice Cream; 3 tbsp Slivered Almonds, Pistachios, Glazed Cherries

Title: Chikoo (Sapota) & Medjool Date Energizer Shake
Tagline: Caramel-sweet brown chikoo fruit blended with soft Medjool dates, chilled milk, and crushed almonds.
Description: Naturally sweet wholesome energy shake. Ripe brown Dahanu chikoos (sapota) blended with soft Medjool dates, cold creamy milk, and soaked almonds with zero refined sugar.
Ingredients_Summary: 3 pieces Ripe Chikoo (Sapota); 4 pieces Soft Medjool Dates; 1.5 cups Chilled Milk or Almond Milk; 6 pieces Soaked Peeled Almonds

Title: Wild Blueberry & Greek Yogurt Antioxidant Smoothie
Tagline: Antioxidant-rich frozen wild blueberries blended with thick Greek yogurt, honey, and chia seeds.
Description: Vibrant violet breakfast smoothie. Frozen wild blueberries whirled with protein-rich Greek yogurt, banana, chia seeds, and raw honey for a velvety, creamy breakfast fuel.
Ingredients_Summary: 1.5 cups Frozen Wild Blueberries; 1 cup Plain Greek Yogurt; 1 piece Frozen Banana; 1 tbsp Chia Seeds & Raw Honey

Title: Creamy Hass Avocado & Honey Green Smoothie
Tagline: Velvety buttery ripe avocado whipped with chilled milk, raw honey, and toasted pistachios.
Description: The buttery indulgence of South Indian hill stations like Munnar and Ooty. Ripe Hass avocado scooped and whipped with ice-cold milk, wildflower honey, and vanilla, topped with chopped green pistachios.
Ingredients_Summary: 1 piece Ripe Hass Avocado; 1.5 cups Cold Milk or Coconut Milk; 2 tbsp Raw Honey; 1 tbsp Pistachios

Title: Classic Strawberry Banana Protein Smoothie
Tagline: Sweet strawberries, ripe banana, oats, and vanilla Greek yogurt blended into creamy pink perfection.
Description: The all-time family favorite smoothie. Sun-ripened red strawberries blended with sweet bananas, rolled oats for sustained fiber, Greek yogurt, and almond milk.
Ingredients_Summary: 1.5 cups Fresh or Frozen Strawberries; 1 piece Ripe Banana; 0.75 cup Vanilla Greek Yogurt; 2 tbsp Rolled Oats

Title: Royal Kesar Pista Badam Shake (Saffron Pistachio Milk)
Tagline: Rich milk simmered with crushed Kashmiri saffron, blanched almonds, and Iranian green pistachios.
Description: The royal celebratory beverage of North Indian weddings. Chilled full-cream milk blended with blanched almond paste, infused with Kashmiri saffron strands, green cardamom, and crunchy slivers of pistachios.
Ingredients_Summary: 500 ml Chilled Full-Cream Milk; 15 pieces Blanched Almonds (Badam); 15 pieces Pistachios (Pista); 12 strands Kashmiri Saffron (Kesar); 0.5 tsp Green Cardamom Powder

Title: Creamy Peanut Butter & Raw Cacao Power Shake
Tagline: Natural peanut butter blended with raw Peruvian cacao powder, frozen bananas, and oat milk.
Description: The ultimate post-workout protein fuel. Pure roasted peanut butter blended with raw dark cacao, frozen bananas, chia seeds, and creamy oat milk.
Ingredients_Summary: 3 tbsp Creamy Roasted Peanut Butter; 2 tbsp Raw Cacao / Cocoa Powder; 2 pieces Frozen Bananas; 1.5 cups Oat Milk or Whole Milk

Title: Malabar Tender Coconut (Elaneer) Pudding Shake
Tagline: Fresh soft tender coconut pulp and sweet coconut water blended with vanilla ice cream and chilled milk.
Description: The tropical hallmark of Kerala coastal juice parlors. Sweet jelly-like tender coconut pulp (vazha) blended with chilled tender coconut water, full-cream milk, and a scoop of vanilla ice cream into a luscious, refreshing ambrosia.
Ingredients_Summary: 1.5 cups Fresh Tender Coconut Pulp (Elaneer Vazha); 1 cup Tender Coconut Water; 1 scoop Vanilla Ice Cream or Condensed Milk; 0.5 cup Cold Milk

Title: Mixed Berry & Chia Seed Breakfast Smoothie
Tagline: Raspberries, blackberries, and strawberries blended with almond milk and plumped chia seeds.
Description: Vibrant antioxidant morning booster. A tart-sweet mix of raspberries, strawberries, and blackberries whirled with plant-based almond milk, banana, and gelled chia seeds.
Ingredients_Summary: 1.5 cups Frozen Mixed Berries; 1.5 cups Almond Milk; 1.5 tbsp Chia Seeds; 1 tbsp Pure Maple Syrup or Honey

Title: Spicy Malabar Kulukki Sarbath (Shaken Chili Lemonade)
Tagline: Sweet basil seeds, slit bird's eye green chili, and lemon juice vigorously shaken with sugar syrup and crushed ice.
Description: The iconic street lemonade of Kozhikode and Kochi. Sweet sabja (basil seeds) soaked until translucent, shaken vigorously in an inverted stainless-steel glass with freshly squeezed lemon juice, sugar syrup, a split spicy green bird's eye chili, and a touch of salt.
Ingredients_Summary: 1 piece Fresh Lemon; 1 tbsp Soaked Sabja (Sweet Basil) Seeds; 1 piece Green Bird's Eye Chili; 3 tbsp Sugar Syrup (Nannari or Cane); 1 cup Crushed Ice & Water; 1 pinch Black Salt

Title: Traditional Kerala Sambharam (Moru / Spiced Buttermilk)
Tagline: Churned sour curd diluted with cold water, crushed shallots, ginger, green chilies, and fresh curry leaves.
Description: The life-giving digestive elixir of Kerala. Freshly churned sour yogurt whisked with cold water, infused with hand-crushed shallots, grated ginger, fiery green chilies, torn curry leaves, and rock salt, left to steep before drinking.
Ingredients_Summary: 1.5 cups Sour Curd / Yogurt; 3 cups Cold Water; 3 pieces Shallots (Cheriya Ulli); 1 tbsp Fresh Ginger & Green Chili; 2 sprigs Fresh Curry Leaves; 1 tsp Sea Salt

Title: Herbal Nannari Sarbath (Indian Sarsaparilla Root Cooler)
Tagline: Sweet aromatic Indian sarsaparilla root syrup mixed with lime juice, basil seeds, and ice.
Description: The time-honored Ayurvedic cooling summer drink of Kerala and Tamil Nadu. Earthy, vanilla-scented syrup extracted from wild Nannari (Naruneendi) roots, shaken with fresh lemon juice, soaked sabja seeds, and crushed ice.
Ingredients_Summary: 4 tbsp Nannari Root Syrup (Naruneendi); 2 tbsp Fresh Lemon Juice; 1 tbsp Soaked Sabja Seeds; 2 cups Chilled Water & Ice

Title: Authentic Punjabi Sweet Lassi with Thick Malai Layer
Tagline: Thick creamy whole-milk yogurt hand-churned with sugar and rosewater, crowned with a dollop of clotted cream (malai).
Description: The legendary street thirst-quencher of Amritsar. Set whole buffalo-milk curd hand-churned in a wooden tall churner (Mathani) with sugar, rosewater, and green cardamom, served in a heavy earthen kulhad crowned with a thick dollop of golden clotted cream (malai).
Ingredients_Summary: 500 g Fresh Thick Whole-Milk Curd / Yogurt; 4 tbsp Cane Sugar; 1 tsp Rosewater & Green Cardamom; 2 tbsp Thick Clotted Cream (Malai); 0.5 cup Crushed Ice

Title: Konkan Pink Solkadhi (Kokum & Coconut Digestive Drink)
Tagline: Tangy wild purple kokum extract blended with fresh creamy coconut milk, garlic, green chilies, and cilantro.
Description: The cooling soul of the Konkan coast. Tart crimson wild kokum rinds soaked in water, blended with freshly squeezed rich coconut milk, infused with crushed garlic, green chili, rock salt, and chopped cilantro into a pastel pink digestive ambrosia.
Ingredients_Summary: 8 pieces Dried Purple Kokum Petals (Aamsul); 2 cups Fresh Thick Coconut Milk; 1 tbsp Garlic Cloves & Green Chili; 1 tsp Pink Rock Salt & Cumin; 2 tbsp Fresh Cilantro

Title: Smoky Roasted Raw Mango Aam Panna
Tagline: Charred green raw mangoes simmered with roasted cumin, mint leaves, and black rock salt.
Description: The time-honored North Indian antidote to the scorching summer loo wind. Green raw mangoes charred over open flames or pressure-cooked, pureed with roasted cumin powder, black salt, fresh mint, and jaggery.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 pieces Raw Green Mangoes (Kacha Aam); 0.5 cup Cane Jaggery or Sugar; 1.5 tsp Roasted Cumin Powder (Bhuna Jeera); 1 tsp Black Salt (Kala Namak); 0.5 cup Fresh Mint Leaves

Title: Famous Madurai Royal Jigarthanda (Almond Gum Cooler)
Tagline: Chilled reduced almond-gum milk layered with nannari syrup and crowned with homemade basundi ice cream.
Description: The legendary heart-cooling street dessert drink of Madurai. Layered with soaked tree-sap almond gum (badam pisin), caramelized reduced milk (kadambur doodh), nannari sarsaparilla syrup, and crowned with a dollop of thick basundi ice cream.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 tbsp Badam Pisin (Almond Tree Gum); 3 tbsp Nannari Syrup; 1 cup Slow-Reduced Caramel Milk; 2 scoops Basundi or Vanilla Ice Cream

Title: Shahi Banarasi Kesar Thandai (Spiced Holi Milk)
Tagline: Stone-ground paste of almonds, melon seeds, poppy seeds, fennel, and black pepper steeped in chilled saffron milk.
Description: The royal Holi festival drink of Varanasi. Whole milk infused with a stone-ground paste of almonds, cashews, magaz melon seeds, khus khus (poppy seeds), green cardamom, sweet fennel seeds, rose petals, and spicy black peppercorns.
Ingredients_Summary: 1000 ml Whole Milk; 50 g Almonds & Cashews; 1 tbsp Fennel Seeds & Black Pepper; 1 tbsp Poppy & Melon Seeds (Khus Khus, Magaz); 1 tsp Kashmiri Saffron & Dried Rose Petals

Title: Traditional Ayurvedic Bel Ka Sharbat (Wood Apple Cooler)
Tagline: Fragrant sweet golden wood apple pulp mashed with water, roasted cumin, and black salt.
Description: Ancient Indian summer cooling elixir. Ripe wood apple (Bel / Bael fruit) cracked open, sweet orange pulp mashed in water, strained of fibrous seeds, and spiced with roasted cumin and jaggery.
Ingredients_Summary: 1 piece Ripe Bael Fruit (Wood Apple); 2 tbsp Jaggery or Sugar; 0.5 tsp Roasted Cumin & Black Salt

Title: Vintage South Indian Rose Milk with Sabja Seeds
Tagline: Chilled fresh milk infused with Damascus rose syrup and floating soft basil seeds.
Description: The timeless summer romance of South Indian city bakeries and cinema halls. Chilled farm milk stirred with authentic fragrant rose syrup and plumped basil seeds (sabja) served in tall frosted glasses.
Ingredients_Summary: 500 ml Chilled Whole Milk; 4 tbsp Pure Rose Syrup or Rooh Afza; 1 tbsp Soaked Sabja (Basil) Seeds

Title: Ocean Blue Curaçao Sparkling Citrus Fizz
Tagline: Vibrant azure orange-peel liqueur syrup, fresh lime juice, and bubbling sparkling club soda over crushed ice.
Description: An electric blue tropical mocktail. Non-alcoholic blue curaçao syrup layered with freshly squeezed lime juice, mint leaves, and effervescent sparkling soda water over towering crushed ice.
Ingredients_Summary: 30 ml Blue Curaçao Non-Alcoholic Syrup; 20 ml Fresh Lime Juice; 150 ml Sparkling Soda Water; 1 piece Lime Wheel & Maraschino Cherry

Title: Classic Virgin Mint & Cuban Lime Mojito
Tagline: Bruised fresh spearmint leaves, muddled Persian lime wedges, cane sugar, and effervescent sparkling soda.
Description: The gold standard of world mocktails. Fresh garden spearmint leaves gently pressed with juicy lime wedges and raw turbinado cane sugar, packed with crushed ice, and topped with chilled sparkling club soda.
Ingredients_Summary: 12 leaves Fresh Spearmint Leaves; 4 pieces Lime Wedges; 2 tsp Cane Sugar; 180 ml Chilled Sparkling Club Soda

Title: Spicy Pink Guava Mary with Red Chili-Chaat Rim
Tagline: Velvety pink guava juice spiced with Worcestershire, Tabasco, lemon, and served in a glass rimmed with red chili and chaat masala.
Description: The bold Indian twist on the Virgin Mary. Chilled pink guava nectar spiked with Worcestershire, Tabasco, black pepper, and lime, served in a glass rimmed with fiery red Kashmiri chili and tangy chaat masala.
Ingredients_Summary: 200 ml Pink Guava Juice; 4 drops Tabasco & Worcestershire Sauce; 1 tbsp Chaat Masala & Red Chili Powder; 1 piece Fresh Lemon Wedge

Title: Crimson Hibiscus (Zobo / Sorrel) Ginger Blossom Cooler
Tagline: Brewed whole dried hibiscus calyces infused with fresh ginger, cinnamon, and sparkling water.
Description: The global red jewel drink celebrated across West Africa (Zobo), the Caribbean (Sorrel), and Mexico (Agua de Jamaica). Deep ruby dried hibiscus sepals brewed with fiery ginger, cloves, and sweetened with raw cane sugar over ice.
Ingredients_Summary: 50 g Dried Red Hibiscus Flowers (Karkadeh); 40 g Fresh Ginger Root; 1 piece Cinnamon Stick & Cloves; 0.5 cup Cane Sugar or Honey

Title: Delhi Street Masala Shikanji (Spiced Sparkling Lemonade)
Tagline: Freshly squeezed lemon juice, black rock salt, roasted cumin, chaat masala, and bubbling cold soda.
Description: The beloved summer street lemonade of Chandni Chowk in Old Delhi. Fresh lemons squeezed over ice, seasoned with aromatic homemade Shikanji masala (roasted cumin, black salt, amchur, black pepper, and mint), topped with crisp soda water.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 pieces Fresh Lemons; 1 tsp Shikanji Masala (Roasted Cumin, Black Salt, Pepper, Amchur); 3 tbsp Sugar Syrup; 300 ml Chilled Club Soda or Water; 1 cup Fresh Mint Leaves & Crushed Ice

Title: Kerala Passion Fruit & Jalapeño Sparkling Spritzer
Tagline: Tangy tropical passion fruit pulp, thin jalapeño rounds, lime, and sparkling tonic water.
Description: Zesty, tropical sweet-heat mocktail. Fresh golden passion fruit pulp shaken with a single round of jalapeño chili, agave syrup, and fresh lime, topped with sparkling tonic water over crushed ice.
Ingredients_Summary: 3 tbsp Fresh Passion Fruit Pulp; 1 slice Fresh Jalapeño or Green Chili Coin; 1.5 tbsp Agave or Simple Sugar Syrup; 150 ml Sparkling Water or Tonic

Title: Cucumber Ribbon & Charred Rosemary Botanical Tonic
Tagline: Crisp cucumber ribbons, bruised fresh garden rosemary, juniper notes, and premium tonic water.
Description: Sophisticated botanical zero-proof cocktail. Shaved English cucumber ribbons spiraled inside a balloon glass, bruised rosemary sprigs torched briefly for herbal woodsmoke aroma, finished with cold craft tonic water.
Ingredients_Summary: 1 strip English Cucumber Ribbon; 1 sprig Fresh Rosemary Sprig; 15 ml Fresh Lime Juice; 180 ml Premium Tonic Water

Title: Pomegranate & Rosemary Sparkling Holiday Fizz
Tagline: Ruby pomegranate juice, elderflower syrup, fresh lime, and ginger ale garnished with floating arils.
Description: Festive celebration mocktail. Tart crimson pomegranate juice shaken with floral elderflower syrup and lime juice, poured over ice, topped with ginger ale, and studded with floating ruby arils and rosemary.
Ingredients_Summary: 80 ml Pure Pomegranate Juice; 120 ml Ginger Ale or Club Soda; 1 tbsp Fresh Rosemary & Pomegranate Arils

Title: Sunrise Orange & Cranberry Layered Mocktail
Tagline: Layered visual delight of golden orange juice, tart crimson cranberry, and a sunken pomegranate grenadine dawn.
Description: The stunning layered visual mocktail. Fresh sweet orange juice layered gently over ice with tart ruby cranberry juice and a heavy splash of pomegranate grenadine settling at the base to recreate a vibrant morning sunrise.
Ingredients_Summary: 100 ml Fresh Orange Juice; 80 ml Tart Cranberry Juice; 15 ml Grenadine Syrup (Pomegranate)

Title: Chilled Lychee & Lemongrass Sparkling Elixir
Tagline: Sweet floral whole lychees muddled with bruised lemongrass stalk, fresh lime, and sparkling soda.
Description: An exotic Southeast Asian botanical mocktail. Sweet floral lychee fruit muddled gently with bruised citrusy lemongrass, fresh lime juice, and topped with crisp sparkling water over ice.
Ingredients_Summary: 4 pieces Canned or Fresh Whole Lychees; 1 stalk Fresh Lemongrass Stalk; 150 ml Fresh Lime Juice & Club Soda

Title: Authentic Kumbakonam Degree Filter Coffee
Tagline: Slow-dripped dark chicory decoction frothed with boiling unadulterated cow's milk in brass Davarah-Tumbler.
Description: The gold standard of South Indian coffee culture. Dark-roasted Arabica and Peaberry coffee beans slow-dripped in a brass percolator filter with 15% chicory, frothed by 'meter-pulling' with boiling fresh cow's milk, and served steaming hot in traditional Davarah and Tumbler.
Ingredients_Summary: 4 tbsp Fresh Ground Filter Coffee Powder (85% Coffee, 15% Chicory); 150 ml Fresh Boiling Water; 300 ml Full-Cream Cow's Milk; 2 tsp Raw Sugar

Title: Authentic Mumbai Tapri Cutting Chai (Ginger-Cardamom)
Tagline: Strong Assam CTC black tea simmered with bruised ginger, crushed cardamom, cloves, and whole milk in a brass pot.
Description: The lifeblood of Mumbai. Strong granular Assam CTC tea simmered repeatedly with freshly crushed spicy ginger, green cardamom pods, milk, and sugar in a brass degchi until dark, robust, and served in iconic fluted cutting glasses.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 tbsp Assam CTC Black Tea Powder; 20 g Fresh Ginger Root; 2 pieces Green Cardamom Pods & Clove; 2 cups Water and Whole Milk; 2 tsp Sugar

Title: Traditional Malabar Sulaimani (Spiced Black Tea with Lemon)
Tagline: Golden brewed black tea spiced with crushed cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and a squeeze of fresh lemon.
Description: The soul of Malabar wedding feasts. Golden-amber black tea gently brewed with whole green cardamom pods, cinnamon bark, cloves, and fresh lemon juice, traditionally served after heavy biryani feasts for effortless digestion.
Ingredients_Summary: 1.5 tsp Loose Leaf Black Tea (Dust or Leaf); 2.5 cups Water; 1 piece Cardamom, Cinnamon & Clove; 1 tsp Fresh Lemon Juice; 2 tsp Sugar or Honey

Title: Kashmiri Noon Chai (Sheer Chai / Pink Salted Tea)
Tagline: Special green tea leaves aerated with baking soda until pink, simmered with milk, sea salt, and pistachios.
Description: The mystical rose-pink tea of Kashmir. Special gunpowder green tea leaves boiled and aerated for 45 minutes with a pinch of baking soda to unlock natural ruby pigments, simmered with whole milk, sea salt, cardamom, and topped with crushed almonds.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 tbsp Kashmiri Special Green Tea Leaves; 0.25 tsp Baking Soda; 2 cups Ice-Cold Water; 2 cups Whole Milk; 0.5 tsp Sea Salt (Noon); 2 tbsp Slivered Almonds and Pistachios

Title: Ceremonial Uji Matcha Green Tea Latte
Tagline: Stone-ground ceremonial Japanese green tea whisked with bamboo chasen, steamed milk, and vanilla.
Description: The zen ritual of Kyoto. Ceremonial first-harvest green tea leaves stone-ground into vibrant emerald powder, whisked vigorously in a bowl with hot water using a bamboo chasen into a frothy jade crema, combined with velvety microfoamed steamed milk.
Ingredients_Summary: 1.5 tsp Ceremonial Grade Uji Matcha; 60 ml Hot Water (80°C / 175°F); 200 ml Oat Milk or Whole Milk; 1 tsp Agave or Honey

Title: Spanish Iced Café con Leche (Sweet Chilled Espresso)
Tagline: Double shot of dark roasted espresso sweetened with cane sugar, poured over rocks with creamy cold milk.
Description: The refreshing morning staple of Barcelona plazas. A double shot of piping hot dark espresso pulled over raw cane sugar, shaken with ice, and combined in equal parts with cold velvety whole milk.
Ingredients_Summary: 60 ml Fresh Double Espresso; 150 ml Cold Whole Milk; 1.5 tsp Cane Sugar; 1 cup Ice Cubes

Title: Authentic Stovetop Turkish Cardamom Coffee (Türk Kahvesi)
Tagline: Ultra-fine pulverized coffee simmered in copper cezve over embers to create signature dense foam (köpük).
Description: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage. Extra-fine pulverized Arabica coffee simmered unhurriedly with green cardamom and cane sugar in a long-handled copper cezve (ibrik) until a dense, velvety crema rises, served unfiltered in demitasse cups with Turkish delight.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 heaped tsp Extra-Fine Pulverized Turkish Coffee Powder; 150 ml Cold Filtered Water; 0.25 tsp Ground Green Cardamom; 1.5 tsp Sugar (Seker)

Title: Vietnamese Iced Coffee (Cà Phê Sữa Đá)
Tagline: Bold dark French-roast robusta dripped through stainless phin filter over sweet condensed milk and ice.
Description: The world-famous street refreshment of Saigon. Dark roasted Robusta coffee dripped slowly through an individual stainless-steel Phin filter directly over thick sweetened condensed milk, stirred vigorously, and poured over ice.
Ingredients_Summary: 3 tbsp Vietnamese Dark Roast Coffee Powder; 2.5 tbsp Sweetened Condensed Milk; 120 ml Boiling Water; 1 cup Ice Cubes

Title: Darjeeling First Flush (Champagne of Teas)
Tagline: Delicate spring hand-plucked tea leaves steeped into a pale golden liquor with floral muscatel grape notes.
Description: The celebrated 'Champagne of Teas' harvested in early spring from the misty Himalayan foothills of Darjeeling. Whole tender two-leaves-and-a-bud steeped gently into a glowing champagne-colored brew with ethereal floral aromas and distinct muscatel grape brightness.
Ingredients_Summary: 2 tsp Single-Estate Darjeeling First Flush Loose Leaves; 400 ml Spring Water (85°C / 185°F)

Title: Ayurvedic Lemongrass, Ginger & Tulsi Kadha (Herbal Infusion)
Tagline: Wild holy basil, crushed ginger root, fresh lemongrass, and black pepper simmered with palm jaggery.
Description: The ancestral immunity-boosting herbal brew of Kerala homes. Fresh homegrown Tulsi leaves, bruised lemongrass, fresh ginger root, whole black peppercorns, and cloves simmered together with palm jaggery (Karupatti) for respiratory wellness.
Ingredients_Summary: 15 leaves Fresh Tulsi (Holy Basil) Leaves; 2 stalks Fresh Lemongrass Stalk; 1 tbsp Fresh Ginger & Black Peppercorns; 2 tbsp Palm Jaggery (Karupatti); 3 cups Water
